facts.text: St. Mary's University traces its history to 1852, when the Brothers of the Society of Mary (Marianists) established Catholic education in San Antonio.

sources.title: History of St. Mary's University | San Antonio, Texas
sources.quote: Brothers of the Society of Mary (Marianists) brought Catholic education to San Antonio in 1852 when they opened St. Mary's Institute.

facts.text: Under its Transfer Promise Program, St. Mary's University covers full tuition for qualified transfer students.

sources.title: St. Mary's launches Transfer Promise Program
sources.quote: St. Mary's University launches Transfer Promise Program, covering full tuition for qualified students
